description: This file contains functions for managing Discord reactions, including reacting, removing reactions, fetching reactions, and removing all reactions on a message, using Discord API types and client functions.

methods.name: createDiscordReactionRuntimeClient
methods.description: Creates a Discord client using the provided runtime context options.

methods.name: resolveDiscordReactionClient
methods.description: Resolves and creates a Discord client, loading config if necessary.

methods.name: isDiscordReactionRuntimeContext
methods.description: Type guard to check if options are a DiscordReactionRuntimeContext.

methods.name: reactMessageDiscord
methods.description: Adds a reaction emoji to a specified Discord message.

methods.name: removeReactionDiscord
methods.description: Removes a specific reaction emoji from a message.

methods.name: removeOwnReactionsDiscord
methods.description: Removes all reactions from a message that the bot has added.

methods.name: fetchReactionsDiscord
methods.description: Fetches reactions and their users for a message.
